verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-infrastructure platform, not an agent itself, so publishing an MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at docs.browserbase.com/integrations/mcp/introduction, which directly covers connecting an agent via MCP. The evidence is only a single pointer to that page, though. Missing for 10: details on the exposed tools, transport and hosting options (local vs. hosted endpoint), setup and authentication steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
